description: This file contains C# classes and interfaces related to Orleans serializer tests within the GrainInterfaces namespace. It defines serializable classes with serializer-related attributes, a class implementing a deserialization hook, and a subclass overriding a property for serializer behavior testing.

classes.name: TypeWithOnDeserializedHook
classes.description: A serializable class with a deserialization hook for testing callback invocation.

classes.name: BaseClassWithAutoProp
classes.description: A base class with an auto-implemented property marked for serialization.

classes.name: SubClassOverridingAutoProp
classes.description: A subclass overriding an auto property to test serializer generation behavior with overridden properties.

methods.name: IOnDeserialized.OnDeserialized
methods.description: Hook method invoked after deserialization to set context.
